mapper.select: select NVL(sum(lo.quantity * p.price), 0) as total_revenue, NVL(sum(lo.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, case when sum(lo.quantity) > 0 then round(sum(lo.quantity * p.price) / sum(lo.quantity), 0) else 0 end as avg_price from lot_out lo join outbound_detail obd on lo.outbound_detail_id = obd.outbound_detail_id join product p on obd.product_id = p.product_id where lo.is_expired= 'N'

select p.product_name, p.price, sum(lo.quantity) as quantity, sum(lo.quantity * p.price) as revenue from lot_out lo join outbound_detail obd on lo.outbound_detail_id = obd.outbound_detail_id join product p on obd.product_id = p.product_id where lo.is_expired = 'N' group by p.product_name, p.price order by revenue desc fetch first 10 rows only

select sale_date, revenue, quantity from ( select to_char(o.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as sale_date, SUM(lo.quantity * p.price) as revenue, SUM(lo.quantity) as quantity from lot_out lo join outbound_detail od on lo.outbound_detail_id = od.outbound_detail_id join outbound o on od.outbound_id = o.outbound_id join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id where lo.is_expired = 'N' and o.approval_status = 'APPROVED' group by to_char(o.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by sale_date asc )
where rownum <= 30
order by sale_date asc

select product_name, waste_quantity, total_quantity, CASE when total_quantity > 0 then ROUND((waste_quantity * 100.0) / total_quantity, 1) else 0 end as waste_rate from ( select p.product_name, NVL(SUM(CASE when lo.is_expired = 'Y' then lo.quantity else 0 end), 0) as waste_quantity, NVL(SUM(lo.quantity), 0) as total_quantity from lot_out lo join outbound_detail od on lo.outbound_detail_id = od.outbound_detail_id join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id group by p.product_name ) order by waste_rate desc fetch first 10 rows only
